A. I am Leo. My cousin works on a farm, and I visit him in summer. He shows me the animals, and I help him feed them. The work is real, but it is fun.

B. My friend Anna is a quick runner. She often wins a prize at school. I cheer for her and take photographs. The red sports bag is hers, but the camera is mine.

C. I like cooking with my brother. He wants to be a chef, and I hope to work in a café. We make food for our family and give it to them at dinner.
